description: This file is a multical wrapper that dispatches calls to either hostapd_main or wpa_supplicant_main based on the invoked program name. It serves as a command-line dispatcher for different wireless services.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Entry point that establishes the command to run (hostapd or wpa_supplicant) based on argv[0], with an optional restart mechanism if additional arguments are provided.
